intent: Let a researcher start from an already-exposed EvidenceFragment id and read the truthful claim-scoped Evidence content plus logical source identity, historical known-time boundary and source capture/materialization provenance without direct SQL, duplicate Evidence ownership, or pretending a readable representation is raw source bytes.
rationale: The database already stores the required semantics: EvidenceFragment locator/excerpt/structured payload; document-version to logical-document identity; publisher/source identity; source first-known/published time; and explicit locator_verified/content_verified/materialized plus raw-materialization provenance. The demonstrated gap is that the public repository boundary writes Evidence but exposes no typed read-by-fragment contract, forcing any researcher drill-down to couple directly to PostgreSQL internals. Extend CAP-0001 with truthful source-identity/capture-state reading and CAP-0002 with typed Evidence-fragment reading. CAP-0005 remains only the navigation surface that exposes Evidence ids; it does not become the Evidence truth owner.
